title: The Red Sea Crossing

questions.question: What did God tell Moses to do when the Egyptians pursued?
options: Lift his staff and stretch out his hand over the sea
questions.correctAnswer: Lift his staff and stretch out his hand over the sea
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:16 (ESV): "Lift up your staff, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it."

questions.question: What happened when Moses stretched out his hand over the sea?
options: The Lord drove the sea back by a strong east wind
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord drove the sea back by a strong east wind
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:21 (ESV): "The Lord drove the sea back by a strong east wind all night and made the sea dry land."

questions.question: What happened to the Egyptian army in the sea?
options: The waters returned and covered them all
questions.correctAnswer: The waters returned and covered them all
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:28 (ESV): "The waters returned and covered the chariots and the horsemen... not one of them remained."

questions.question: What did Moses say to the people when they were afraid of the Egyptians?
options: Fear not, stand firm, and see the salvation of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Fear not, stand firm, and see the salvation of the Lord
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:13 (ESV): "Fear not, stand firm, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will work for you today."

questions.question: How did the Israelites walk through the sea?
options: On dry ground with walls of water on both sides
questions.correctAnswer: On dry ground with walls of water on both sides
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:22 (ESV): "The people of Israel went into the midst of the sea on dry ground, the waters being a wall to them on their right hand and on their left."

questions.question: Where did God tell the Israelites to camp before the crossing?
options: In front of Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea
questions.correctAnswer: In front of Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:2 (ESV): "Tell the people of Israel to turn back and encamp in front of Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea."

questions.question: What moved from in front of the Israelites to behind them?
options: The angel of God and the pillar of cloud
questions.correctAnswer: The angel of God and the pillar of cloud
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:19 (ESV): "Then the angel of God who was going before the host of Israel moved and went behind them, and the pillar of cloud moved from before them and stood behind them."

questions.question: What did the pillar of cloud do between the Egyptians and Israel?
options: It gave light to Israel but was darkness to the Egyptians
questions.correctAnswer: It gave light to Israel but was darkness to the Egyptians
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:20 (ESV): "And there was the cloud and the darkness. And it lit up the night without one coming near the other all night."

questions.question: What did God do to the Egyptian army in the morning watch?
options: He looked down and threw the army into a panic
questions.correctAnswer: He looked down and threw the army into a panic
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:24 (ESV): "In the morning watch the Lord in the pillar of fire and of cloud looked down on the Egyptian forces and threw the Egyptian forces into a panic."

questions.question: What happened to the chariot wheels of the Egyptians?
options: He clogged their chariot wheels so that they drove heavily
questions.correctAnswer: He clogged their chariot wheels so that they drove heavily
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:25 (ESV): "Clogging their chariot wheels so that they drove heavily."

questions.question: Why did God tell Israel to camp by the sea, making it look like they were trapped?
options: So Pharaoh would think they were wandering and pursue them
questions.correctAnswer: So Pharaoh would think they were wandering and pursue them
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:3 (ESV): "For Pharaoh will say of the people of Israel, 'They are wandering in the land; the wilderness has shut them in.'"

questions.question: How many chariots did Pharaoh take to pursue Israel?
options: 600 chosen chariots plus all the others
questions.correctAnswer: 600 chosen chariots plus all the others
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:7 (ESV): "He took six hundred chosen chariots and all the other chariots of Egypt."

questions.question: What did the Egyptians say as they fled from Israel?
options: Let us flee, for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians
questions.correctAnswer: Let us flee, for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:25 (ESV): "Let us flee from before Israel, for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians."

questions.question: What did the people of Israel do after seeing the great power of the Lord?
options: They feared the Lord and believed in the Lord and Moses
questions.correctAnswer: They feared the Lord and believed in the Lord and Moses
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:31 (ESV): "Israel saw the great power that the Lord used against the Egyptians, and the people feared the Lord, and they believed in the Lord and in his servant Moses."

questions.question: What famous phrase does Moses use about God fighting for Israel?
options: The Lord will fight for you, and you have only to be silent
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord will fight for you, and you have only to be silent
questions.explanation: Exodus 14:14 (ESV): "The Lord will fight for you, and you have only to be silent."

key_verse_text: The Lord will fight for you, and you have only to be silent.
